title: Prove a conditional GL64 parent-stock envelope for the selected BIT bootstrap
head: 8001a23b003bec5dff5e61edec907b652c475932
body:
## Claim and scope

Under the selected supplier's **retained full-cover and completed ordinary-leaf interfaces**, the PR589 nine-stage BIT stopped producer has

\[
\log_q S(e,w)\le8194\,w(1+\log_2 e).
\]

This gives an explicit numerical parent-stock coefficient for PR1965's H3 at the first native bootstrap stage. Its recorded cutoff `L=4785575287428` passes the sufficient stock-fit guard with `sigma=8194` and `ceil(log2(8*sigma))=17`, so `ceil(log_q S(e,w))<e/2` for every integer `e>=2^L`, with the selected `w=ceil(e^s)`.

**This is a conditional space implication, not a new supplier, new κ, proof of H2, physical all-size implementation, or adoption of the outer proof.** The selected frontier and all predecessor files are unchanged.

## What is new

PR1956 and PR1965 distinguish carried time constants from stock constants; PR1990 independently checks the cutoff headroom and leaves the actual selected reserve coefficient uncomputed. This contribution derives that coefficient from the selected **ordinary BIT producer**, rather than importing the historical `m=120` coefficient or treating the external `252` allowance as an internal reserve.

The selected assembler uses `BIT_M=64`; the separate complex supplier has `m=73` and constrains the atom exponent `s`. The selected PR589 receipt has 28,416 live roles, 28,425 physical roles, and maximum child rank 42. The old row pricer already contains `2*(64^2+1)=8194`; novelty is the quantified divisor/depth/restoration implication that makes this a stopped-parent envelope, not that arithmetic or the already known headroom.

## Proof and domain

Fix an eligible odd prime `q>2^80`, positive integers `e,w`, and `0<=n<=e` coarse atoms. Retain the selected compiler/hosting interpretation with one complete physical-role packet per active coarse level and internally completed ordinary leaves.

1. The actual complete packet divisor is `W_q(w)=28425*|GL_64(F_q)|*q^(4096*(w-1))`. Reduction modulo `q` gives the local-ring cardinality, hence `log_q W_q(w)<4096*w+1<=4097*w`. High matrix fibers and all nine extra physical roles are charged; moment normalization does not remove row stock.
2. Every good child is at most `42*floor(n/64)`; conservative fallback children are at most `floor(n/64)`. Since `2*42^2=3528<4096`, two levels halve. The active internal depth satisfies `D(n)<=2*ceil(log2 n)` without an unnamed additive constant.
3. `S=W_q(w)^D` is a divisible reserve. A node exposes one role packet and passes the unused quotient to its children. Completed children restore it, so siblings, residuals and the two ordinary-wrapper calls reuse the same reserve. Completed ordinary leaves borrow internally and contribute external factor one, as in the reviewed PR185 contract. This is not a bound on their internal memory or time.
4. These yield `sigma=8194`. Exact rational binding to the first selected native stage checks `L*delta^2>=36`, `L*delta>=2*(4+17)` and `0<delta<=1-s`. PR1965's sufficient fit lemma applies. Its known guard headroom is 6,562,783 bits; that comparison is not claimed as new.

The proof expressly retains the full-cover/physical-slot realization, fresh-field and completed-leaf interfaces. A finite receipt does not prove them. If an old leaf requires an external factor, or a child fails to restore its row, the no-extra-factor conclusion fails; the controls exercise both countermodels. H2's time/descriptor bound and all other all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, hosting, precision/tape, recovery and analytic obligations remain open.

## Evidence and reproduction

Package: `research/selected-bit-parent-reserve/` (proof, source/task/selection metadata, exact receipt, verifier and controls).

Observed locally with standard-library CPython 3.12:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-parent-reserve
```

Output includes:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_PARENT_RESERVE m=64 sigma=8194 stage=1 floor_cases=20001 local_rings=3 row_states=27
Ran 14 tests
OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-bit-parent-reserve outcome=completed
```

The replay authenticates every external source and the immutable archive member before semantic use; no predecessor Python is executed. It compares a canonical regenerated receipt, independently checks the floor-depth recurrence on 20,001 atom counts, enumerates three small local-ring cases, and checks arbitrary-row restoration/reuse. Fourteen tests pass under `-O`, including wrong producer, lost work roles, false halving, missing high fibers, insufficient divisible stock, external-leaf and restoration countermodels, source/member corruption and cutoff mutations. The all-width claim rests on the written proof, not those finite examples. No full selected cold replay, formal kernel, or hosted-CI success is claimed.

Their source results and receipts are not claimed as new. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed; Apache-2.0.

Submission overlap used 353 open PRs (including drafts) and 738 discussion/comment/reply records with complete pagination, followed by targeted live predecessor-head checks. Concurrent public handoffs [18932014](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18932014) and [18932040](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18932040) target the separate complex `m=73` producer, the latter specifically its rank-48 depth factor while leaving the divisor open. This contribution instead binds the ordinary BIT `m=64` divisor and complete parent envelope. Those claims are provisional leads, not adopted results; absence of other matches is not a novelty certificate.

Next useful tasks are to realize the selected GL64 packet/compiler map with complete spectator preservation, and separately prove the stopped time estimate whenever stock fits with a cutoff-independent constant. Start with one source-bound parent/child address split and a fully quantified routing/leaf/descriptor/high-part-exchange bill, respectively. These are explicit remaining obligations, not implicit consequences of this certificate.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
